static_traits.name: Li Bowen
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and a younger sibling
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with teammates tense due to Self-doubt; has support resources from friends and parents, but has not yet fully shared Self-doubt and helplessness
static_traits.medical_history: Never had similar psychological problems; without prior psychotherapy or counseling experience; without major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, capable of self-Reflection, highly cooperative; emotionally tense but maintains a hopeful and cooperative attitude

basic_info.main_problem: After Today's relay race loss, I feel I am a bad runner, which in turn produces helplessness and Self-doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: This helplessness is affecting my motivation to keep running and my overall physical and mental health.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one game is lost, it means my overall ability is poor
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles training efforts and pushes oneself harder in practice to prove oneself

special_situations.event: Moments after performing below one's own Anticipation in the race
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not achieved my set results, it means I failed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Pushing oneself harder in practice to compensate for inadequacy
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: What if I mess up again?

special_situations.event: When interacting with teammates, thinks one has dragged the team down
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I perform poorly, I will disappoint teammates and drag down the team
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Becoming more Withdrawn, reducing communication with teammates to avoid being evaluated

special_situations.event: Situations of investing heavily in training yet not obtaining ideal results
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I still fail after trying hard, it means I am simply not competent enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continues doubling training to prove oneself, while ignoring or belittling past successes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Effort is also useless; I am just not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a capable runner, winning teammates' and self-affirmation
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of failing, disappointing teammates, and being negatively evaluated by others
defense_goal: Reducing the possibility of being judged and disappointed through self-withdrawal
Controlling Anxiety and proving oneself through harder training

object_relations.object_representation: Teammates dragged down by me, who will be disappointed

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about competition losses or team performance, or feeling others watch their performance
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to believe others will be disappointed and negatively evaluate oneself (projecting self-criticism onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Hesitant tone, increased defensiveness, repeating Self-denial judgments, struggling to discuss concrete evidence, tending to give short answers to avoid in-depth discussion.

manifestations: Investing heavily in practice yet failing, experienced as 'all effort does not matter'
Starting to lose the joy and meaning of running
Becoming more Withdrawn due to Self-doubt
Reduced interaction with teammates, Relationship tension

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessive self-reproach, labeling oneself a 'terrible runner'
Hard to accept teammates' positive feedback and comfort

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Becoming more Withdrawn, reducing communication with teammates
Turns disappointment and pressure into self-blame and doubled training

positive_force: Has won competitions and achieved personal bests, has real ability and positive evidence
Has social support resources from parents and friends
Willing to seek counseling and do recording and restructuring of thoughts, with a positive attitude
High training engagement and good discipline
negative_force: Overgeneralization and black-and-white thinking leading to wholesale negation of the self
Personalization tendency, blaming team outcomes and others' feelings on oneself
Focusing on failure, ignoring positive evidence, Reinforcement of Self-doubt
Self-withdrawal after competitions, reducing interaction and support with teammates
Predicting future failures intensifies Anxiety and Decreased motivation

target_behavior.behavior: Intense Self-denial and Withdrawal after the race
antecedent: Repeatedly recalling mistakes in the competition
Thinking 'what if I mess up again'
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralization, personalization and black-and-white thinking formed after the relay race loss, Interpreting one failure as overall helplessness
target_behavior.function: Avoids the risk of being judged and failing again, temporarily protecting self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased drive in training, disrupted daily routine and exercise plans; Relationship tension with teammates, team coordination affected
